name: Майстерня зв’язок (2)
description:
It is time for a pin party again. In the pin party, you use an existing pin. This pin prevents an enemy piece from adequately performing its defensive tasks. Take advantage of this by capturing material.

What do you have to do?

Win material by using a pin. The pin prevents an enemy piece from properly performing its defensive tasks.

examples.text: The bishop on e4 seems well protected, but nothing could be further from the truth. White plays 1.Rxe4! and Black cannot recapture because of the vertical pin on the f-file.
White has problems on the back rank and Black takes advantage with 27...Qxd4! A recapture now leads to a quickcheckmate.
